notes: Source: AJA's own product/spec page (https://www.aja.com/products/hi5-4k-plus), which is authoritative for the core video I/O and power spec. Device is a 3G-SDI-to-HDMI 2.0b converter (SD/HD/3G up to 4K/UHD): 4x 3G-SDI BNC inputs (SMPTE-259/292/424) feed a single HDMI Type A output (HDMI v2.0b, up to 4:4:4/36-bit, HDR InfoFrame support) — there is no SDI output/loop-through on this model, video only exits via HDMI. Embedded audio: SDI in up to 24-bit/16-channel, HDMI out 24-bit/8-channel (no discrete/analog audio connectors). No Ethernet, RS-422, or genlock/reference BNC on this model per AJA's spec sheet. Desktop/deskbox form factor (5.76 x 4.02 x 0.90 in, 0.6 lb) — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Overall confidence set to medium rather than high solely because the USB connector's physical style/speed and the exact locking-power-connector geometry are not stated on the manufacturer page and had to be inferred/approximated to the closest catalog connector id; the video/audio I/O itself is high-confidence and directly sourced from AJA.

ports.name: USB (Mini-Config)
ports.note: Used only for device configuration via AJA Mini-Config software. AJA's spec page confirms a USB port but does not state the physical connector style (Micro-B vs Type-C) or USB speed — connector id inferred from typical AJA Mini-Converter generation design; verify before relying on it.

ports.name: DC Power In
ports.note: AJA specifies a proprietary 'locking power connector' (not a generic 2.1mm barrel) accepting 5-20VDC regulated, 12W, supplied with an included universal 100-240VAC/50-60Hz external adapter. Mapped to the closest available connector id (dc-barrel).
